title: Leading with dignity and building trust in polarized politics
discussion_signal: The post presents dignity, disagreement without contempt, and fair participation as ways to rebuild trust and democratic culture. Replies largely affirm the initiative, while the post itself is an institutional proposal rather than evidence that trust changed.
linked_research_question: How ideas of dignity, fairness, and respectful disagreement turn institutional experience into trust, belonging, or political participation.
limits: Institutional initiative and selected professional audience
Affirmative replies do not measure broader public response
The post cannot show whether the proposed program changes behavior or trust
